newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian bonds ease, seen holding.
newsitem.headline: Austrian bonds ease, seen holding.

text.p: 1530 GMT - Austrian bonds were easier on Monday, mirroring bearish international response to the outcome of the first round of French voting, traders said.
Volume was low, with many investors sidelined because of a holiday in Britain and the U.S.
Market seen sideways ahead of U.S. data on Wednesday.
Long end under some pressure, reasonable demand seen for the latest 4.625 pct five-year bond.
* 10-year benchmark 5.75 pct bond maturing July 2006 down five bps at 98.90 to yield 5.90 (5.89) pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 98.74/82 to yield 5.92/91.
* Five-year 4.625 bond maturing May 2002 closed at 98.80 in bourse trade to yield 4.90 pct, quoted post-market at 98.72/80 to yield 4.92/90 percent.
* Austrian bond future down four bps at 108.05 on turnover of 30 lots.
* 10-year spread over Germany down one at minus one bp, five-year spread up 15 at 20 bps.
* Money market rates mixed with three-month VIBOR firmer at 3.402 and overnight money weaker at 3.07/3.32. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 256
